editorial_evidence.title: BRI needs a balance sheet, not an announcement counter
editorial_evidence.dek: Trade, construction, lending, utilization, fiscal cost and local welfare are different ledgers. The gap between them is where the real analysis starts.

sections.heading: Scale without a consolidated balance sheet
paragraphs: China's 2025 BRI-country trade aggregate is enormous, but an aggregate relationship with a class of countries is not a project return. Exports, imports, direct investment and contracted construction revenue belong in separate columns; none is a substitute for an audited schedule of lending, debt service, project cash flow and host-country fiscal cost.

The analytical discipline is stocks versus flows and commitments versus observed operation. A road can be physically complete while its traffic is thin; an investment stock can coexist with weak current cash generation; contracted revenue for a Chinese builder can be a liability or fiscal burden somewhere else.

sections.heading: The upside is real enough to measure—and conditional enough to audit
paragraphs: The World Bank's corridor model supplies a serious pro-integration case: shorter travel times can support trade, investment and income. It also supplies the necessary warning label. Gains can disappear when infrastructure cost, debt stress, stranded capacity, corruption, environmental damage and displacement are omitted.

The correct scorecard therefore nets observed logistics and welfare gains against financing, operating, environmental and legitimacy costs. It does not choose between an official success narrative and a blanket failure narrative before the denominators arrive.

sections.heading: A rights-adjusted project return is an economic measure
paragraphs: Consultation, land rights, civic freedom and credible remedy affect construction delay, guarding, insurance, utilization and the durability of concessions. That does not turn every rights allegation into proven project causality. It means political legitimacy is a balance-sheet variable that should be investigated rather than edited out.

Palimpsest's proposed project scorecard keeps physical completion, utilization, external-account return, local distribution, consultation, displacement, civic freedom and evidence freshness in separate fields.

evidence.source_name: National Bureau of Statistics of China
evidence.source_title: Statistical Communique of the People's Republic of China on 2025 National Economic and Social Development
evidence.statement: China reported RMB 23.6018 trillion of 2025 goods trade with countries in its BRI classification, including RMB 13.6851 trillion of exports and RMB 9.9167 trillion of imports; nonfinancial direct investment was RMB 283.4 billion and contracted-project revenue RMB 1.0902 trillion.
evidence.interpretation_limit: Country-classification aggregates do not show that BRI caused the trade, identify project cash flows or measure distribution to host communities.

evidence.source_name: State Council Information Office of China
evidence.source_title: A Global Community of Shared Future: China's Proposals and Actions
evidence.statement: China's official account describes BRI participation as voluntary and mutually beneficial and reports 2013-2022 goods trade of $19.1 trillion with partner countries and cumulative two-way investment of $380 billion.
evidence.interpretation_limit: This is the Chinese government's position and aggregate accounting, not independent verification of project profitability, consent or local welfare.

evidence.source_title: Belt and Road Economics: Opportunities and Risks of Transport Corridors
evidence.statement: A full-corridor scenario was modeled to reduce corridor travel times by as much as 12 percent, increase corridor-economy trade by 2.8 to 9.7 percent, raise real income by 1.2 to 3.4 percent and potentially lift 7.6 million people from extreme poverty.
evidence.interpretation_limit: These are modeled scenarios before infrastructure costs, not observed outcomes from completed projects. The report also identifies debt, stranded assets, corruption, environmental damage and displacement as material risks.

evidence.statement: The Committee expressed concern about reported enforced disappearances and extrajudicial killings, particularly in Balochistan and Sindh, noting more than 10,000 alleged-disappearance cases registered from 2010 through August 2025, more than 9,000 administratively disposed cases and no criminal convictions.
evidence.interpretation_limit: The figures are registered allegations and administrative statuses. 'Disposed' does not mean every allegation was disproved or remedied, and the observations are not individual criminal judgments.

evidence.source_name: Office of the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights
evidence.source_title: Annual update on the human rights situation in Myanmar, 2025
evidence.statement: OHCHR reported that Myanmar's military remained responsible for the great majority of verified incidents and civilian casualties, while anti-military armed groups also committed serious violations; verified civilian airstrike deaths rose from 641 in 2024 to 982 in 2025.
evidence.interpretation_limit: The report distinguishes verified incidents from reports received and does not make every armed actor or political opponent interchangeable.

evidence.source_title: Towards a Peaceful, Fair and Prosperous Future for the People of Rakhine
evidence.statement: The commission concluded that Kyaukpyu oil, gas and infrastructure investments had not yet produced significant employment or other benefits for local communities and recommended participation, compensation, strategic environmental assessment and consultation.
evidence.interpretation_limit: This is a 2017 baseline and must not be presented as a current project-status measurement without newer evidence.

method: Use exact official or institutional records for every numeric statement and keep modeled values, official claims, attributed allegations and documented findings in separate evidence states.
Write data-dense external-account and project-lifecycle analysis without imitating any living writer's distinctive prose.
Treat unavailable as unavailable, never zero; distinguish commitment, construction, completion, operation and utilization.
Publish state and project counterpositions beside critical evidence without allowing them to erase incident-specific findings or allegations.
Never merge electoral politics, peaceful civic advocacy, separatist advocacy, armed organizations, state actions or affected communities into one actor.
limitations: This is a desk synthesis of cited public records, not field reporting or a judicial finding.
Sources may revise live pages after the as-of date; the URL and publication clock remain visible for re-checking.
National data cannot establish provincial or project causality, and conflict data cannot establish that infrastructure caused violence or repression.
The source set is broad but not exhaustive; challenges, counterevidence and corrections can be submitted through Palimpsest's public challenge route.

sources.notes: Country and sector ODI aggregates; stock, flow and non-financial ODI must remain distinct.

sources.name: China Belt and Road Portal
sources.publisher: Office of the Leading Group for Promoting the Belt and Road Initiative
sources.notes: Official announcements and policy framing; reported status is not independent completion verification.

sources.name: China Customs bilateral trade statistics
sources.publisher: General Administration of Customs of China
sources.notes: Preserve reporter, partner, valuation basis, commodity classification and revisions.

sources.name: World Bank BRI transport-network replication dataset
sources.notes: CC BY 4.0 replication files; modeled network and market-access scenarios are not current project-status records.

sources.name: World Development Indicators
sources.notes: World Bank compilation of national context with indicator-specific upstream authority, modeled-estimate labels, revisions and source clocks; it is production-verified context, not independent project, actor, corridor or causal BRI evidence.

sources.name: International Debt Statistics
sources.notes: Public and publicly guaranteed external debt aggregates; creditor coverage and timing must accompany every value.

sources.name: UN Comtrade
sources.notes: Reporter-partner-product flows; mirror asymmetries, CIF/FOB basis and revisions must be retained.

sources.name: World Economic Outlook Database
sources.notes: Observed and projected years must remain distinguishable; check IMF reuse terms before redistribution.

sources.name: PortWatch trade-disruption and port-call estimates
sources.publisher: International Monetary Fund and University of Oxford
sources.notes: Modeled trade and port activity; never represent as customs value or port-authority throughput.

sources.name: Global Chinese Development Finance Dataset 3.0
sources.notes: Project-level research dataset using TUFF methodology; license and redistribution terms require review before ingest.

sources.name: China's Overseas Development Finance Database
sources.publisher: Boston University Global Development Policy Center
sources.notes: Tracks CDB/CHEXIM public and publicly guaranteed loan commitments, not disbursements, repayments or total debt.

sources.name: China BRI investment and construction reports
sources.notes: Research estimates of construction contracts and investment; methodology and deal definitions travel with totals.

sources.name: China Global Investment Tracker
sources.notes: Large transactions only under the producer's definitions; do not infer comprehensive coverage.

sources.name: Global Energy Ownership Tracker and Global Integrated Power Tracker
sources.notes: Current ownership and power-project tracker family; obtain and retain each dataset license and version before redistribution.

sources.name: CPEC official project portal
sources.publisher: Ministry of Planning, Development and Special Initiatives, Pakistan
sources.notes: Official CPEC portfolio and reported status; needs independent corroboration for completion, operation and outcomes.

sources.name: Gwadar Port Authority projects and operations
sources.notes: Port-authority project record; capture release dates and archive each status revision.

sources.name: Pakistan Public Sector Development Programme and project documents
sources.notes: Budgeted allocations and releases are not total project cost or verified physical completion.

sources.name: Pakistan debt policy statements and fiscal reports
sources.notes: Separate external debt, public debt, guarantees, contingent liabilities and creditor categories.

sources.name: Pakistan balance of payments, external debt and investment statistics
sources.notes: Retain flow/stock, resident/nonresident, instrument and revision semantics.

sources.name: Pakistan trade, labour and price statistics
sources.notes: Use published aggregate tables; provincial and district comparability varies by survey.

sources.name: Balochistan budget books
sources.notes: Budget allocation, release and expenditure must stay separate; map project codes across years.

sources.name: Balochistan statistical publications
sources.publisher: Bureau of Statistics, Planning and Development Department, Balochistan
sources.notes: District aggregates provide the local baseline; survey dates and geographic definitions must travel with values.

sources.name: Balochistan development plans and project records
sources.publisher: Planning and Development Department, Government of Balochistan
sources.notes: Provincial development record; preserve scheme identity and fiscal-year revisions.

sources.name: Election Commission of Pakistan results and party records
sources.notes: Electoral results and administrative records; political positions must not be mapped to armed actors.

sources.name: Pakistan list of proscribed organizations
sources.notes: The published list describes itself as not a legal document; cite the underlying authority where available and never treat listing as adjudicated guilt.

sources.name: UK proscribed terrorist groups and statutory instruments
sources.notes: Preserve effective date, statutory instrument and aliases as legal scope, not independent proof of conduct.

sources.name: US Federal Register foreign terrorist organization notice for BLA
sources.publisher: US Department of State and Federal Register
sources.notes: US legal designation and aliases; administrative legal status is not an adjudication of every attributed event.

sources.name: OFAC sanctions actions and SDN changes
sources.notes: Attributed administrative action, not a court finding; delistings and program authority must remain visible.

sources.name: UN Special Procedures communications concerning Balochistan
sources.publisher: Office of the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights
sources.notes: Communications transmit allegations and requests for response; they are not findings unless a separate adjudicative record says so.

sources.name: UCDP annual conflict aggregates (reviewed public context)
sources.notes: Version 26.1 annual aggregate context is live at /readings/ucdp-aggregate-latest.json with its exact /readings/ucdp-aggregate-release-receipt.json. The reviewed Git lock binds the captured rights page, dated review and expiry, three required citations, and three immutable inputs; only annual administrative-area context crosses the boundary, never tactical coordinates or person-level dossiers. Country-year fatality bounds for Pakistan are national, not Balochistan-only, and no row supports NarcoScope actor, route, project, guilt or causal inference.

sources.name: ACLED conflict-event data
sources.publisher: Armed Conflict Location and Event Data
sources.notes: No scraping or public redistribution; use only under an appropriate license and publish permitted aggregates.

sources.name: Human Rights Commission of Pakistan reports
sources.notes: Civil-society reporting; retain allegations, sourcing and response status rather than promoting claims to findings.

sources.name: Myanmar-China joint statements on CMEC
sources.notes: Joint political and project-status statements; language such as promote or explore is not completion evidence.

sources.name: Myanmar Port Authority development projects and Kyaukpyu port pages
sources.notes: Port authority record; archive status revisions and keep proposals separate from operational assets.

sources.name: Myanmar investment approvals and company information
sources.publisher: Directorate of Investment and Company Administration, Myanmar
sources.notes: Investment approvals and company records; approval is not disbursement, construction, completion or operation.

sources.name: Myanmar Economic Monitor
sources.notes: Macroeconomic and household context; estimates, nowcasts and observed statistics must remain labeled.

sources.name: Myanmar Opium Survey 2025
sources.publisher: United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime
sources.notes: Survey and remote-sensing estimates; uncertainty, geographic scope and crop-year definitions are mandatory.

sources.name: UN Myanmar humanitarian reporting
sources.publisher: United Nations in Myanmar and OCHA
sources.notes: Humanitarian aggregates and situation reports; population denominators, access constraints and publication dates must travel with claims.

sources.name: Independent Investigative Mechanism for Myanmar annual reports
sources.publisher: United Nations Independent Investigative Mechanism for Myanmar
sources.notes: Mechanism reporting and evidence-preservation status; never expose protected evidence or convert investigative statements into adjudicated findings.

sources.name: Copernicus Sentinel-2 imagery
sources.notes: Use delayed coarse project-footprint change detection only; no tactical monitoring, person tracking or vulnerability mapping.

sources.name: China, Pakistan, Myanmar and the Belt and Road deep research report
sources.notes: Reviewed non-tactical analysis route. Only the exact HTML and PDF reports plus a publication receipt are public. Machine sources, evidence, claims, run manifest and Markdown working report are withheld because those rows have no per-transform publication decision; the report does not authorize tactical, person-level, actor, route, project, guilt or causal joins to NarcoScope.

sources.name: NarcoScope China-Pakistan-Myanmar official aggregate
sources.notes: Production-verified v2 artifact at NarcoScope merge 5bf6a31cfd98e56dadca495f35b99ecb73c1d74f; exact artifact and schema bytes, REST, MCP 1.1.0 and MCP Registry 1.1.0 were independently checked. Geography-and-time-only join; no movement, actor, project, route, guilt or causal inference.

source.indicator_provenance_boundary: World Bank indicator titles are preserved and reviewed; dataset licensing does not convert a national series into project-level or causal BRI evidence.
